name: Exp. Share as an on/off key item
author: PokePat
description: The Exp. Share becomes a key item that is switched on and off from the bag (or the registered-item button) instead of being held. While it is on, the Pokémon that battled share the normal Exp. and every other healthy party member gets half of it. The setting is stored in the save file (flag FLAG_EXP_SHARE_ENABLED). When it is off, the original rules apply.

edits.anchor:
"An item to be held by a Pokémon.\n",
    "The holder gets a share of a battle’s\n",
    "Exp. Points without battling."
edits.text:
"Turn it on to share a battle’s\n",
    "Exp. Points with all of your\n",
    "Pokémon. Use it again to turn it off."

static BOOL UseExpShareInField(ItemFieldUseContext *usageContext);
static void UseExpShareFromMenu(ItemMenuUseContext *usageContext, const ItemUseContext *additionalContext);
BOOL expShareEnabled = VarsFlags_CheckFlag(SaveData_GetVarsFlags(battleSys->saveData), FLAG_EXP_SHARE_ENABLED); // PokePat mod platinum-exp-share

usage: Give the player ITEM_EXP_SHARE (it goes to the key items pocket). Using it shows "Exp. Share on." / "Exp. Share off.". Uses the unused save flag 0x053C – do not use FLAG_UNUSED_0x053C for anything else.
